prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: actual production key drawings for a 2D game mushroom-nest growth animation, NOT a preview mockup. Make a strict 3 columns x 3 rows sheet of nine COMPLETE isolated mushroom nests on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, generous empty gutters, no text, grid, numbers, shadows, particles, glow or background. Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom.

References: image 1 is the exact SMALL stage-1 approved design, image 2 is the exact ADULT stage-2 approved design. Preserve their salmon pink cap, dark maroon underside, ivory padded cradle and stem, soft golden highlights, thin dark green outline, painterly cartoon finish, upper-left lighting and slightly top-down frontal camera. Image 3 supplies ONLY the fully lowered cap posture, not a new nest design.

All nine cells use the SAME square canvas coordinate system. Ground/root is bottom center at x50%, y87.5% of each cell. NEVER individually zoom or center a drawing. Stage1 main-cap width is 58% of cell width and cradle width 43%. Adult main-cap width is 73% of cell width and cradle width 66%. Medium dimensions are exactly halfway between these sizes. Every sprite fits fully inside its cell.

Cell 1: EXACT small stage1 neutral pose as reference1. Two coral eggs, no side mushroom.
Cell 2: SAME small cradle and eggs absolutely unchanged, main cap lowered halfway, stem compressing, cap not growing.
Cell 3: SAME small cradle and eggs unchanged, main cap fully lowered, curled downward like a closed umbrella touching the cradle, hiding the stem and most egg tops.
Cell 4: MEDIUM SIZE after first sudden growth. Cap remains fully lowered over cradle. Intermediate cradle thickness and cap size, three eggs developing beneath. No upward neck gap.
Cell 5: FULL adult size after second sudden growth. EXACT adult cradle design, three eggs and right-side small mushroom exist, but main cap remains FULLY LOWERED and nearly touches front cradle. Side mushroom may be occluded by the lowered main cap. Growth has ENDED here.
Cell 6: SAME full adult cradle, eggs, side mushroom and main cap size as cell5. Main cap starts to rise, one-quarter of the way up. Reveal a short part of the stem.
Cell 7: SAME adult anatomy and proportions, cap halfway up.
Cell 8: SAME adult anatomy and proportions, cap three-quarters up.
Cell 9: EXACT adult reference2 final relaxed upright pose.

CRITICAL: Cells1-3 are identical body size. Cell3 -> cell4 -> cell5 are the ONLY two size increases. Cells5-9 are identical final body and cap size, ONLY head posture changes. Keep the cradle, eggs and side mushroom perfectly registered and identical across the adult row: redraw the cap and stem posture as necessary without inventing new cradle folds. Do not scale up the whole nest to fake growth. Do not lift the head during either growth step. Connected anatomy, clean continuous contours, complete surfaces and true transparency. The nine cels will be used directly as animation source artwork.
